title: Sanna spelunking in the sewers

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Hey! So you found me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! So you found me!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: So you know I told you I was a cave spelunker?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you know I told you I was a cave spelunker?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Well, I haven't really quit. I mean I SHOULD quit. But it's hard. Because of "her".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I haven't really quit. I mean I SHOULD quit. But it's hard. Because of "her".

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I had an accident. Shattered both knees on a sharp decent. My support rope slipped and I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had an accident. Shattered both knees on a sharp decent. My support rope slipped and I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: My... old partner. We did everything together, but we loved exploring the caves most of all. Or we did until I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My... old partner. We did everything together, but we loved exploring the caves most of all. Or we did until I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Ouch indeed. Two shattered knees and a shattered heart. My partner didn't exactly sit by my bedside during my convalescence. She was out exploring caves with "Zack" before I'd even gotten my medical bills.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ouch indeed. Two shattered knees and a shattered heart. My partner didn't exactly sit by my bedside during my convalescence. She was out exploring caves with "Zack" before I'd even gotten my medical bills.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: What do YOU think? Two replacement LifeCorp Narbascular Knee Caps with aluminum braces. Until I pay them off, they run in "basic motive functionality" mode.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do YOU think? Two replacement LifeCorp Narbascular Knee Caps with aluminum braces. Until I pay them off, they run in "basic motive functionality" mode.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That's his name, don't wear it out! ...Prick. You know he sent me a "Get Well" message with a little animated bunny? I think they were already fucking by then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's his name, don't wear it out! ...Prick. You know he sent me a "Get Well" message with a little animated bunny? I think they were already fucking by then.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Well I can walk. And that's about it for the next... forty-five years. Unless I get enough cash to unlock the full functionality, and no offense, but I'm not going to get that much money cooking noodles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I can walk. And that's about it for the next... forty-five years. Unless I get enough cash to unlock the full functionality, and no offense, but I'm not going to get that much money cooking noodles.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Stupidity. I heard there was some basic cave systems you could access in the sewers through some old hatches. Once inside, they only required some basic scrambling. But...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stupidity. I heard there was some basic cave systems you could access in the sewers through some old hatches. Once inside, they only required some basic scrambling. But...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: But even that's still too hard for me right now. And... I heard they would be down here. Zack and... my old partner. I probably wanted to see them, even though it would make me spiral.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But even that's still too hard for me right now. And... I heard they would be down here. Zack and... my old partner. I probably wanted to see them, even though it would make me spiral.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: It sticks in the throat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sticks in the throat.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: No. Obviously. Do I look like a woman making good decisions right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Obviously. Do I look like a woman making good decisions right now?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Hey, you're probably right. Fuck it. What am I doing? I gotta get out of here. Thanks, boss. If you are my boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you're probably right. Fuck it. What am I doing? I gotta get out of here. Thanks, boss. If you are my boss.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Thanks, boss. If you are my boss, I guess? I'll see how far I get. Probably nowhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, boss. If you are my boss, I guess? I'll see how far I get. Probably nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wasn't looking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't looking.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why should you quit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why should you quit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who is "her"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who is "her"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ouch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Zack?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zack?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How bad were the medical bills?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How bad were the medical bills?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How bad were the medical bills?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How bad were the medical bills?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that bad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that bad?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Does your injury still bother you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Does your injury still bother you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Does your injury still bother you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Does your injury still bother you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why are you here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a good idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't even say her name huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't even say her name huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can't even say her name huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can't even say her name huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you should go home.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you should go home.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you should go home.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you should go home.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck with the cave exploring.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck with the cave exploring.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Good luck with the cave exploring.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Good luck with the cave exploring.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember.
